_comment: NON-RUNNABLE INSTALLATION TEMPLATE for Gemini CLI user-level hooks. Prefer plugins/gemini/install.sh, which renders verified absolute runtime paths. Project-source hooks may be gated by the harness trust setting and are not a substitute for user-level installation.
_paths_note: Replace @HESTIA_WORKSPACE@ and @HESTIA_PLUGIN_ROOT@ before installation, then verify every command target exists. Unrendered placeholders must never be installed: a missing hook process may fail open in the harness.
_hooksConfig_note: Pin "hooksConfig": {"enabled": true} in settings.json alongside this block. It defaults true, but "enabled": false disarms every hook and hooksConfig.disabled can disable this gate by command string. Operator's prerogative, but it must be visible to anything auditing the member.
